title: Five reporting habits that save a public office at audit time
excerpt: Simple, repeatable habits that make audits less painful for small public offices.
content_md:
### Why habits matter

Small public offices often fail audits not because of fraud but because of missing paperwork and inconsistent processes. Here are five reporting habits that help:

- Keep a single

folder
- Reconcile petty cash weekly
- Tag documents with receipt dates

**Consistency** beats last-minute heroics.
